title: Portfolio
subtitle: Projects I have designed and deployed

padelboy.name: PadelBoy
padelboy.description: An intuitive tool for managing Padel tournaments. It supports popular formats (Americano and Mexicano), offers automatic match generation, smart multi-court scheduling, and historical player statistics. The app works offline directly in the browser with no registration required.

coop.name: Coop
coop.description: An application for energy cooperatives designed to analyze energy flows and ensure the equitable distribution of both energy and finances among members.

statsperform.description: Led the development of automated sports commentary for the Opta Stream and Opta Live platforms. Managed the team and architected real-time sports data processing systems.

flex.description: Developed an internal Bill of Materials (BOM) optimization tool, empowering factory engineers and procurement teams to make data-driven decisions and conduct informed negotiations.

thomsonreuters.description: Built automated data collection systems for energy market analysis and reporting.

asseco.description: Ensured quality for the P1 project—a multi-company government initiative aimed at centralizing and digitalizing healthcare systems in Poland.
